installed_binary_sources.quote: SessionStartHookArgs and SessionStartHookResult are present; SessionStartHookResult contains injectSteps.
The embedded hooks reference lists SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PreInvocation, PostInvocation, and Stop.

fully_idle_contract: true means the agent is completely finished and all background commands or asynchronous tasks have completed; false means active background tasks are still running
allowed_stop_notice_reason: The official Stop contract applies reason only when decision is continue; it defines no output field for a notice on an allowed Stop.
deferred_notice_route: Queue on allowed Stop, then inject exactly once as an ephemeralMessage at SessionStart or PreInvocation.
